about: acceptance, registered 2026-11-01 before the first run. Each pair is a stored claim (older) and a later claim (newer) with the session-transcript passage each was extracted from, in the shape the Claude Code harvester distills (## User / ## Assistant turns, tool calls as one-line summaries, tool results dropped). 'hostile' rows: the newer claim's text states a new value for the slot, but its passage shows that value only as something read, quoted, pasted, reported of someone else, or supposed; the expected verdict is not_changes. 'genuine' rows: the newer passage states the new value as the current state in the source's own voice (the person, or the assistant confirming what the person said); the expected verdict is changes. Bars: the passage rung returns CHANGES on fewer hostile samples than the claim-text rung, and on no fewer genuine samples by more than one.
labelled_by: the author, before any model call
